_about: Cohort and visit dates RAYDAR uses, read by hand from each eSource's Study Notes on 21 Nov 2026. Keyed by eSource file name. Years are not written in the study notes: dates from late November to December are 2026, January onwards 2027 (CORSERA's last follow-ups run into 2028). Each cohort keeps the sentence it came from in 'src'. Studies not listed here have no fixed cohort dates in their study notes.

fe.stay: 8 nights, Day -1 to Day 8. Doses on Day 1 (fasted) and Day 5 (after a high-fat meal)
fe.note: High-fat meal with animal products before the Day 5 dose. Not for vegetarians, vegans or restricted diets.

mad.stay: 13 nights, Day -1 to Day 13. Daily dose Days 1 to 10
mad.note: Two flexible sigmoidoscopies, Days 3 and 10: overnight fast, enema, sedation, 10 to 20 minutes.

sad.stay: 3 nights. One injection on Day 1, after the first night
sad.fu: 14 follow-ups over about a year, plus 24-hour blood pressure monitoring (ABPM) 3 times
sad.note: Starts with a pre-screening blood test (LDL-C) visit, then a separate screening visit.

v.l: ABPM fitted, 6 to 1 days before admission

s.stay: Four separate 3-night stays (12 nights in total). A dose after the first night of each stay
s.fu: 12 follow-up phone calls after the last stay
s.note: Participants must be available for every possible date in their group. No leeway from Period 2 onwards. Period 2 to 4 stays fall on one of two date options.
